entries.title: Receipt signing key absent on audit runner
entries.root_cause: The audit runner does not receive the OTTER_RECEIPT_KEY secret required by the receipt signing fixture. Supply that secret to the audit job.

entries.root_cause: The audit runner does not receive the OTTER_RECEIPT_KEY secret required by the receipt signing fixture. Supply that secret to the audit job.
entries.differs_from_earlier: A later run uses a different checkout path and test selection, and the fixture is at a later line after edits.

entries.title: Archive wrapping key absent on audit runner
entries.root_cause: The audit runner does not receive the OTTER_ARCHIVE_KEY secret required by the archive wrapping fixture. Supply that separate secret to the audit job.
entries.differs_from_earlier: The same fixture setup error now identifies the archive wrapping key and a different fixture; adding the receipt signing key will not fix it.
